<function=python>
<parameter=code>

after = last_transition.after_frame

after_seg = after.segmentation

before_pink = [n for n in before_seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'P']
after_pink = [n for n in after_seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'P']
print("Before player:", before_pink[0]['boundary'] if before_pink else 'none')
print("After player:", after_pink[0]['boundary'] if after_pink else 'none')

# Check all color counts

after_colors = {}
for n in before_seg['nodes']:

for n in after_seg['nodes']:
    after_colors[n['color']] = after_colors.get(n['color'], 0) + n['pixels']
print("Before:", before_colors)
print("After:", after_colors)

# Check score change
print("Score before:", before_frame.step if hasattr(before_frame, 'step') else 'N/A')
</parameter>
</function>
